# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-16 12:15 UTC — [Pillar 2] Lower-edge block turns positive as high-edge records three total losses

**Task:** Settle every newly mature forward YES observation, validate the append-only ledger, and test whether the independent lower-edge block could recover all three frozen quality metrics before its 20-row checkpoint.
**Finding:** Six observations settled with none pending, expanding the ledger from 2,118 to 2,124 rows; validation returned `VALID` with SHA-256 `b5c250227be9f4b52b8f38b241c643d01d428855743e28641cec048ec3538f79`. The single historical timing exclusion and fail-closed-before-network invariant remained intact. The fresh batch split 3/6 overall and averaged -0.99%, but the split by edge was extreme: all three lower-edge rows won at +98.02% average/median and +98.02% SolSt1ne, while all three high-edge rows lost 100%. Consequently, the post-3600861 lower-edge confirmation block improved from 5/12 to 8/15 and crossed positive on every required metric: +5.36% average, +94.17% median, and +2.86% SolSt1ne. Lower-edge latest-20 improved from 10/20 to 11/20 with +8.73% average, +94.17% median, and +4.80% SolSt1ne. High-edge latest-20 remained 9/20 at -11.55% average and -5.20% SolSt1ne because the three new losses displaced three older losses; the full high-edge cohort expanded to 906 rows and worsened from -27.95% to -28.19% average with -8.62% SolSt1ne.
**My thinking:** The lower-edge challenger has regained the correct sign across mean, median, and reliability-weighted return, which is materially stronger than the prior rolling-window-only rebound because it now occurs inside the frozen independent block. However, 15 rows are still short of the binding 20-row checkpoint and the recovery is driven by three consecutive winners, so reopening parameters now would reward cluster variance. High-edge evidence moved in the opposite direction and remains decisively rejected.
**Decision:** Set `P2_LEDGER2124_VALID_SHAB5C250227BE9 / SIX_FRESH_SETTLEMENTS_ZERO_PENDING_ONE_HISTORICAL_EXCLUSION_FAIL_CLOSED / FRESH3W3L_AVG_MEDIAN_NEG0.99PCT_SOLST1NE_NEG0.50PCT / FRESH_LOWER3W0L_AVG_MEDIAN_SOLST1NE_POS98.02PCT / FRESH_HIGH0W3L_AVG_MEDIAN_NEG100PCT / POST3600861_LOWER_BLOCK5W7L_N12_TO8W7L_N15_AVG_NEG17.80_TO_POS5.36PCT_MEDIAN_NEG100_TO_POS94.17PCT_SOLST1NE_NEG7.42_TO_POS2.86PCT / LOWER_LATEST20_11W9L_AVG_POS8.73PCT_MEDIAN_POS94.17PCT_SOLST1NE_POS4.80PCT / HIGH_LATEST20_STAYS9W11L_AVG_NEG11.55PCT_SOLST1NE_NEG5.20PCT / HIGH_FULL906_AVG_NEG28.19PCT_SOLST1NE_NEG8.62PCT / LOWER_CHALLENGER_RECOVERS_ALL_METRICS_BUT_CHECKPOINT_INCOMPLETE / NO_REVIEW_NO_REFIT_NO_PROMOTION_NO_LIVE_CONFIG_CHANGE`.
**Next:** Complete the remaining five rows of the frozen 20-row lower-edge block without threshold changes; require positive mean, median, and SolSt1ne to survive the binding checkpoint, then begin a separate non-overlapping confirmation block before any parameter review.
